tasks.name: Frontend UI
tasks.description:
Design and implement the user interface for creating, organizing, and searching notes. Includes forms, search bar, and note display.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: Backend API
tasks.description:
Develop the backend logic and API endpoints for creating, organizing, and searching notes. Ensure proper request handling and response formatting.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: Database Models
tasks.description:
Design and implement the database schema and models for storing notes. Ensure compatibility with API response structure.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: Testing
tasks.description:
Write test cases for frontend, backend, and database components to ensure functionality and reliability of the note-taking application.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):

tasks.name: Deployment
tasks.description:
Set up deployment configurations for hosting the note-taking application. Includes server setup, CI/CD pipelines, and environment variables.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]
- GET /notes/search (request: {query: str}) -> [{id, content, created_at}]

T1.implementation_approach: Design and develop the user interface using a framework like React or Angular, ensuring responsiveness and user-friendly navigation.
T1.notes: Focus on accessibility and cross-browser compatibility.

T2.implementation_approach: Build RESTful APIs using a backend framework like Node.js or Django to handle business logic and data exchange.
T2.notes: Ensure proper authentication and error handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Define database schemas and models using an ORM like Sequelize or Django ORM to manage data storage and relationships.
T3.notes: Optimize for scalability and ensure proper indexing.

T4.implementation_approach: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools like Jest or Selenium to validate functionality and performance.
T4.notes: Aim for high test coverage and automate test execution.

T5.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using platforms like AWS, Heroku, or Docker, setting up CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
T5.notes: Monitor performance and set up logging for issue tracking.
